answer_2.quote: To overcome these limitations, we adopt Spearman correlation as our primary evaluation metric. Spearman correlation captures the ordinal structure of the data and is robust to monotonic scale transformations...

answer_3.quote: A particularly interesting research avenue is the use of existing LLMs to identify high-quality content. This 'LLMs as judges to filter datasets' approach has proven highly effective in selecting high-quality data... We investigated LLM capabilities in assessing the quality of multilingual documents.

answer_4.quote: To construct a multilingual ground truth dataset... we conducted a human annotation study involving 15 annotators... employing the educational prompt defined by Fineweb-Edu as annotation guidelines.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate whether the page has a high educational value using a 6-point scoring system based on criteria including relevance to educational topics, alignment with standards, clarity, and depth.
